description: Publish gate for published/locales.json (ADR-0177 section 2). Only overrides and the default live here. min_coverage = shipped strings / English keys per surface. max_broken_ratio = units omitted for a broken placeholder / ICU argument / HTML tag set, as a share of the surface's keys: above it the surface is withdrawn (systematically wrong). Style checks in Weblate never block (owner, 2026-11-04). human_reviewers is the list of Weblate accounts whose approval counts as a human review; empty today, so every locale carries the AI label and legal text stays English. Weblate's public API cannot list team membership, so this list is the record.
